answer: Borrow antitrust's leniency rule and turn every farm into a room full of possible informants. Each ID keeps a 20-token bond in a vault (size assumed). Anyone who can prove several IDs share one operator, say keys co-signing one message, may whisper it privately to auditors: the first valid report earns half the cluster's bonds, the rest burns, and an informer inside the cluster keeps its own bond. A 100-ID farm becomes a 1,000-token prize for any contractor, host or clone key that talks, while an honest island has nothing to confess.
